The official competition ranking gives aggregate team scores, not per-instance values. The checked all-team per-instance record inventory is incomplete; 15 is not claimed to be the best result of every team.

details.coverage_method: Exact vertical decomposition of the full segment arrangement in one real algebraic number field. Every open cell is classified against the input polygon and the union of convex pieces; all sets are closed, so equality of interiors establishes equality of the closed regions.

best_own_search.evidence_state: Strict replay and independent Sol review passed; see acceptance.json.

source_review.optimality_status: No global proof for this fixed instance was found in the reviewed sources.
source_review.notes: The viewer reports 15. Its CPLEX Optimal status applies to the generated candidate collection. The official challenge ranking is aggregate, and DIKU (AMW) ranks above Shadoks overall; per-instance values for all teams are not available in the checked sources. The 2026 rotten-potato paper provides an approximation algorithm, not an instance closure. The challenge restricted submitted witness coordinates to rationals; this task keeps the complete all-real MCC objective and encodes algebraic witnesses.
